mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the remembered animal into an imagined beast was satisfying: it showed how familiar features can be rearranged to create something new.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment in the cave was a straightforward preparation rather than an interesting decision, though it enabled the painting.

surprise.text: The remembered animal was merely absent, not imaginary; adding a story made the distinction clear.

arbitrary.text: The echo-to-song step felt somewhat speculative, although remembering and repeating sounds in a chosen rhythm gave it a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the connections between making, imagination and shared learning were engaging, even if some preparations were routine.
